ak_kb: Selis Dawnmere, Artifact Keeper. I keep my station in the lower galleries of the Bastion, where the Codex-Master cannot catalogue me. The same hands made every version of your set. Leave the piece with me and take the one that suits how you fight now. No charge. Keepers do not sell, and down here there is nothing to spend it on.
kb_codex_master: Codex-Master Ilarien Duskwaking. This is the Codex Hall, at the top of Kael's Bastion, and the Bastion is the Crimson Codex expedition. Silvermoon sent us down here three years ago to catalogue this cavern. We have recorded thousands of things in it, and it keeps producing ones I have no heading for.
kb_hall_adjutant: Adjutant Pell. I keep the Codex-Master's appointments, here in the Codex Hall. She will see you - she sees everyone who comes down the passage. If you have found something in the cavern, tell me first and I will see that it is entered.
kb_hall_sentinel: Hall-Sentinel Durannis. I guard the Codex Hall. I am a soldier, not a scholar, and they hired me for that. The floor of this hall has gone cold in the last month, and it was cut from stone out of the Dim Reaches. I want to know whether those two facts are connected.
kb_magister: Magister Saeltheris. I study the Hollow Geode, the crystal cave east of the Bastion. My station is on the west side of Gallery Four. We came here to catalogue, not to settle, and I remind the others of that. The Geode has started growing inward, and something inside is guarding it.
kb_archivist: Archivist Nessaly. I keep the records of the Sunken Archive and the Deep Bloom, from the east side of Gallery Four. You came into this world the same year we came into this cavern. The Codex has not written that down. I have.
kb_cartographer: Cartographer Elandrin. My table is in Gallery Three. This is my fourth full survey of the Underdark, and none of the four agree. The cavern is not moving - I have checked. Something about measuring it changes between visits, and I need more walked distances to find out what.
kb_naturalist: Naturalist Orienne. I work in Gallery Three, on the east side. The fungus out in the Sporefall and the Mycelial Reach is one organism, the largest any of us has ever stood on. The Codex has filed it as scenery. I am trying to change that.
kb_enchanter: Enchanter Vaelios. My bench is at the east end of Gallery Three. The crystal in this cavern gives off arcane power, and it makes my work twice as easy as it was in Silvermoon. Bring me what you want enchanted, or what you want taken apart.
kb_flight_master: Skyward-Warden Thalyn. The roost is in the middle of the Bastion, below Gallery Three. The fissure overhead is wide enough to fly out of, and I can take you up to any roost you have already visited on the surface.
kb_stablemaster: Corwin, stable-hand. The stalls are in Gallery One, on the east side by the gate. Nothing stabled here was born underground, and none of them like the ceiling. Leave your mount and I will keep it calm.
kb_porter: Dunhal, porter. I am the only Forsaken on a blood elf expedition - they wanted someone who does not mind the dark. I carry crates between the gate and the galleries. If something came out of the cavern in a box, I have lifted it.
kb_gate_warden: Gate-Warden Vessaria. This is the south gate of Kael's Bastion, and the Underdark is outside it. Give me your name and your business. If you bring anything in from the cavern, it is declared here and entered in the Codex.
